_comment: Round 2: 7 findings closed, of which 2 were defects introduced by round 1's FIXES. The two reopens carry the SAME file+rule as round 1 but a DIFFERENT line (42->57, 17->23) and reworded summaries — a rule-based fingerprint must still match them. The other 5 are genuinely new.

findings.summary: the round-1 fix moved the guard below the dereference, so session.user is unchecked again
the ORDER BY added in round 1 was dropped when the query moved into the helper
slice(0, 255) can split a surrogate pair before encodeURIComponent, which throws
the new guard has no else, so a failed check falls through
the members loop is now unbounded over user-supplied data
the reduced-motion branch makes the animation synchronous
the refresh token is written to the info log
